recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, contemporary music cover featuring a vertical acoustic guitar as the primary anchor, surrounded by stylized flat-vector flowers and colorful confetti dots against a soft peach-to-white gradient background. The left side is dedicated to bold, stacked sans-serif typography with a warm red-to-orange gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical guitar neck acts as a central divider between text and decorative elements
Floral clusters overlap the guitar body to create depth
Confetti dots mirror the colors found in the title gradient and floral accents
Left-aligned text block balances the right-aligned illustrative cluster
coreInvariants: Warm peach and coral color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Acoustic guitar positioned vertically on the right third of the frame, scaled to nearly full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The guitar body and the large-scale title text in the top-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title (top-left), moves down the list of names, then sweeps right across the guitar body and up the neck through the confetti trail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room in the top-right and bottom-left corners to maintain a clean, modern feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Soft peach and cream background gradient providing a warm, inviting base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep coral and rust red used for primary typography and guitar details.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal, yellow, and lavender found in the confetti and floral petals.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key background with medium-saturation elements; the title uses a high-contrast gradient for legibility.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or harsh primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing in the main title
Open counters in the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus on clean, unmodified geometric forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and sizes of the same sans-serif family or closely related geometric faces.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric clarity for the title.
Excellent versatile geometric sans for both title and list text.
Classic geometric choice for a clean, modern look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft peach-to-white vertical gradient background. On the right side, place a vertical acoustic guitar illustration. Surround the guitar body with flat-vector, stylized flowers in white, coral, and lavender. Add a trail of colorful confetti dots (teal, yellow, red) floating upwards from the guitar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the top-left using a bold geometric sans-serif with a red-to-orange vertical gradient. Below it, add a subtitle and a list of names in a medium-weight sans-serif, left-aligned, in a solid coral color.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar positioned on the right?
Is the color palette warm and pastel-leaning?
Are the flowers stylized vector art rather than photos?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the guitar headstock
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text overlaps the guitar strings or soundhole
Check that the gradient in the title is smooth and vibrant
Verify the confetti dots don't obscure the artist list
Confirm the background remains soft and does not compete with the foreground
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans Typography + Vertical Instrument Anchor + Flat Floral Accents + Warm Pastel Gradient
